limitationTriage.limitation: Existence only: an even-degree polynomial need not give distinct quadrature nodes, nonzero weights or good conditioning.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Are the zeros of the even-degree polynomials simple with nonzero Christoffel weights for every alpha and x?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Considered as an extension in the revision round (REVIEW_SUMMARY.md); not tractable then.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: The general Carnicer-Mainar-Pena critical-length conjecture and the n >= 4 cases remain open; the n = 3 corollary depends on an unrefereed preprint.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the rank-three input be certified independently, and do higher odd-rank first-zero comparisons hold?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Considered in the revision round; flagged as conditional in abstract, introduction and proof.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: verify.py checks formulas and conventions at finite sizes, not the statements for all sizes.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks fail when a formula is corrupted, including under python -O?
